purpose: Test a universal entry + pre-close exit capsule without changing the stable /wc hot path.
invariants: No new hot-path writes before productive work.
Exit capsule is read once before terminal E9 only.
Missing exit observability never blocks truthful close or safety boundary.
Current stable worker remains the production lane until separately superseded.

experiment_plan.first_test: 1-3 bounded workers only after stable baseline reaches target cleanly
experiment_plan.promotion_gate: No material regression in completion/safety/throughput and exit report adds reconstructible evidence across independent replicas.
